description: This file is a Java source code for a REST controller named PersonController. It defines endpoints for CRUD operations on person entities, including creating, retrieving (by ID and paginated list), updating, and deleting persons. The controller uses Spring annotations for request mapping and dependency injection, and incorporates Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PersonController
classes.description: A REST controller managing CRUD operations for Person entities, exposing endpoints for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting persons.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new person based on the provided request object and returns the response wrapped in an ApiResponse.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a person by their ID, returning a wrapped ApiResponse.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of persons, with optional sorting parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing person by ID with the provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a person by their ID.
